scope: Actual original-map PIE player and NPCs, original Blueprint ProcessEvent dispatch, actual constructed UMG UButton OnClicked delegates, and original DecideItem calls. Runtime fixture snapshots are restored. No physical keyboard/mouse or rendered UI claim.

target_geometry_fixture.scope: Three original NPCs are made visible and actor-collision-enabled only for the fixed direction fixture. The original hidden/collision flags and transforms are captured and restored. This isolates spatial selection; scheduled NPC availability is not its contract.

target_selection_matrix.scope: Fixed three-original-NPC geometry, 30 predefined unique nearest-direction cases; rotate the actual player Actor only. Does not assert camera targeting or physical key input.
target_selection_matrix.oracle: Predeclared NPC position indices; no runtime recreation of the production selection algorithm. Exact angular ties excluded; no new tie or front-only contract.

rare_item_sampling.rng: Engine FMath::RandInit seed; original RandomFloatInRange graph
rare_item_sampling.acceptance_rule: Predefined broad sanity interval 0.07 <= observed rate <= 0.13, not exact population probability proof.

behavior_decorator_sampling.scope: Actual original decorator event on a runtime instance with the actual PIE player as OwnerActor. Does not claim a full behavior-tree traversal or quest award.
behavior_decorator_sampling.acceptance_rule: Predefined broad sanity interval 0.07 <= observed rate <= 0.13; no full-quest execution claim.
